description: A rooftop terrace or balcony of a contemporary flat-roofed home at dusk. The building facade is smooth exterior plaster in a pale warm greige, and the terrace floor is laid with large-format pale grey stone tiles over which a natural jute area rug is placed. A modular outdoor sofa in light grey weather-resistant fabric sits against the wall with a single deep brown throw pillow. At the right side of the terrace, a large rough-textured ceramic garden vessel in a worn white-cream finish stands directly on the tile floor. A small round solid wood side table in natural walnut tone sits to the left in front of the sofa, holding two small ceramic bowls and a tiny teal ceramic vessel. A slim glass railing on the terrace perimeter reveals a residential rooftop and tree line in the middle distance under the blue-grey dusk sky. Through the wide black-framed sliding glass door, an interior living space is visible — a glimpse of a bookshelf lit with warm amber interior light and a sofa, with sheer white curtains drawn loosely to one side. Two diverging beams of warm golden light fan downward across the facade from a single position on the wall to the right of the door opening, grazing the smooth plaster surface and illuminating the terrace immediately below. Camera is at standing eye-level, three-quarter view of the terrace corner, with the house facade occupying the right half of the frame and the seating area the left. Mood is quiet and serene.
